$comment: The app's architecture facts. check-boundaries.mjs and check-layout.mjs add these to their defaults (the canonical src/ zones, SDK classifications and bans). Every entry is an architecture decision: change it in its own commit, together with eslint.config.mjs where the same list lives there. Filled for this harness: the template's two vendorSdks, the test build's test-only folders (debug-menu-and-test-hooks' four, design-visual-parity's harness) and one reasoned exception, the harness's parity launch screen.

allowedImports.reason: The parity launch screen (design-visual-parity, examples/parity-launch-screen.tsx) is the test build's bridge between the debug hooks and the parity harness: it builds the ParityAppliers from useTestHooks() and renders ParityLaunchRoot. Both folders are test-only, reached only through the test-only entry.
